title: 孟磊降息利好科技：财政发力却难定赢家，消费与科技，谁先受益？
speaker: Lei Meng

segments.en: Yeah, so the first one on monetary policy, rate cuts is benefiting the liquidity sensitive sector.
segments.zh: 好的，第一，货币政策方面，降息利好流动性敏感板块。

segments.en: So that means TNT tech-related sector will benefiting from monetary policy easing.
segments.zh: 这意味着科技相关板块将受益于货币政策宽松。

segments.en: And number two, on the physical side, physical policy is more political rather than economical.
segments.zh: 第二，财政方面，财政政策更多是政治性而非经济性。

segments.en: So actually, it's not purely comes out which sector will be the beneficiaries.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，并不能单纯判断哪些板块会成为受益者。

segments.en: Actually, it's more about long-term structural reform for China economic rebalancing or the long-term plan for China economic growth.
segments.zh: 实际上，这更多关乎中国经济再平衡的长期结构性改革，或中国经济增长的长期规划。

segments.en: So I will highlight number one, consumption is still keep priority. And last year, we saw consumer trading subsidy.
segments.zh: 所以我要强调第一，消费仍是优先事项。去年我们看到了消费以旧换新补贴。

segments.en: And for this year, that could be spreading out of into more consumer, for example, the services related areas.
segments.zh: 今年可能会扩展到更多消费领域，比如服务相关领域。

segments.en: Number two, because carbon neutrality, tech, AI development are still the key focus for China.
segments.zh: 第二，因为碳中和、科技、AI发展仍是中国的重要焦点。
